brief:
Ms Rachel, a prominent US content creator, called for more celebrities to speak out against the Gaza genocide, Al Jazeera English reported. She argued that public figures have a responsibility to use their platforms to address the conflict.

The appeal comes as debate intensifies over celebrity silence on major geopolitical and humanitarian issues, with some prominent figures facing criticism for not taking public stances on the situation in Gaza.
dek: US content creator Ms Rachel has called for more celebrities to speak out against the Gaza genocide.
title: US creator Ms Rachel urges celebrities to denounce Gaza genocide
